title: Floyd's Shoulder Roll, at Home
sub: Monday to Friday. Inspired by Floyd Mayweather's defence, not his exact program.
note: The shoulder roll (Philly shell): lead shoulder up to take the right hand, lead hand low to catch the jab and guard the body, rear hand by the chin. Floyd's signature finish is the pull counter: lean back out of range, then fire the right hand.

items: Lead shoulder up, chin tucked behind it, lead hand across your stomach, rear hand on your cheek.
Every punch returns to the shell.
Shoulder rolls off an imaginary right hand
Turn the lead shoulder in and roll, don't lean back.
String at chin height: roll under it to the lead side, come up in the shell.
Roll, then fire the right hand straight back.
Shift weight to the back foot, lean just out of range, eyes on the target.
Pull, then right hand as you come forward. Snap it back to the shell.
Pivot on the lead foot as you hook.
Light and fast, like Floyd's rope sessions.
Fast straight punches, shell between bursts.
Roll or pull every 3rd punch you imagine, counter every time.
